    AI Overview
    The 2026 Sidemen Charity Match takes place on Saturday, April 18, and can be watched for free via a live stream on the official Sidemen YouTube channel. The stream starts around 2:10 pm BST, with kick-off scheduled for 3:00 pm BST. 
    Where to Watch: 
    • YouTube: The official Sidemen YouTube channel.
    • TV/Smart Device: Use the YouTube app on your smart TV, console, or casting device to watch the stream. 
    Key Details for 2026: 
    • Date: Saturday, April 18, 2026.
    • Location: Wembley Stadium, London.
    • Time: 2:10 pm BST (Stream), 3:00 pm BST (Kick-off).
    • Teams: Sidemen FC vs. YouTube Allstars.
    • Charity: Proceeds from the match go to various British charities, including Bright Side. 
    For the most up-to-date information, including team rosters and charity donation links, check the official Sidemen FC website.
